data.name: Third Person Camera
data.desc:
**This mod is incredibly buggy, the game obviously was not made for this.**

A brand new perspective for Rockay City.

![](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jWKWU2uD6Bw)

Allows for the user to go into third person, default button to do so is T. Features a BUNCH of options for configuration, you should mess with those when you start.

BUGS:

- Certain characters may have floating/broken appendages (hair,etc). Baker and Touchdown are some for example
- Female Boss appearances have broken primary weapon animations (for some reason? Female teammembers work though)
- Quick melee does not work all the time

I hope I can fix these, but the blueprint is a fucking mess.

CONTROLS:
**Toggle Third Person - "T"
Shoulder Swap - "Z"**
data.short_desc: Adds a third person toggle to the game.

New adventures await buddy
Better than story mode

data.name: Peak's Rifle
data.desc:
Sitting in the game files since release, Peak's Rifle can now finally see the light of day. All it needed was a custom first person scope setup, everything else was already done.

The mod adds it as a custom weapon (same stats as regular sniper rifle) and gives it to Peak, with working lobby pose (only for him).

Note: Due to weird rendering bugs, it does not use the sniper scope reticle, instead using one from the Vortex 3x sight found on other weapons.

data.name: Holy Hand Grenade
data.desc:
Erase your enemies with your holy energy. Works the same as the holy nade from Worms, so if you don't have enough health, you will get downed.


Got this little idea while working on Mr. Norris, a fun little thing. The model was also created quickly in Blender, designed after the OG holy hand grenade from Worms: The Directors Cut.

And yes, the "hallelujah" sound is also included. :D
